name: Learn several reliable jokes
blurb: Not a comedy career — three or four jokes you can actually land, with the timing rehearsed. Delivery does most of the work.
gear: A note on your phone for material
steps: Choose material that suits you: a long shaggy-dog story, a short one-liner, a self-deprecating observation. Borrowed style never works.
Learn the structure: setup, then a pause, then the punchline with the funniest word placed last.
Rehearse until the wording is exact. Jokes fail on a fumbled setup far more often than on a weak punchline.
Practise the pause. Beginners rush into the punchline and flatten it.
Learn how to recover when one dies — a shrug and a move on, never an explanation.
Test each joke five times and drop whichever consistently underperforms.
tips: Laughing at your own joke before the punchline gives it away and kills it.
Read the room. The joke that kills at the pub can end an evening at work.
proof: Three jokes that reliably land with people who have never heard them.
